items.text: Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, limited/DNP Wednesday practice but expects to play Sunday at Houston. Got mental reps; calls sitting out 'ridiculous'.
items.why: Self-reported tightness post-Week 1 hit; confident in availability.
items.implication: Start with slight risk; monitor Thursday practice. Chase/Higgins unaffected if plays.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (rib) will not practice Wednesday per Jim Harbaugh; early negative sign.
items.why: No practice after leaving Week 1 early with chest/rib.
items.implication: Risk of missing or limited; waiver Tre Harris if available.
items.opportunity: Zero or reduced if out; beneficiaries gain routes/targets.

items.text: Ravens placing rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.why: Surgery to quicken recovery; short-term IR.
items.implication: Drop in shallow leagues; Bateman/Moore elevated.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week after Stribling injury; strong Week 1 target share and red-zone work.
items.why: Stribling long-term absence elevates Deebo opportunity in SF offense.
items.implication: Priority add for WR depth/flex; immediate upside.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes/snaps with Stribling out ~10 weeks.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Track rest of week; start if full, else pivot.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.implication: Potential lead role return; reverse any handcuff beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes if clears; monitor final status.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to hamstring injury.
items.why: DNP first practice of week for hamstring.
items.implication: Monitor; potential elevated role for backups if misses.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans for IR.
items.implication: Drew Lock starts; impacts SEA pass-catchers slightly.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps; JSN etc. still viable.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only four specialized offensive snaps in Week 1 (jet sweep, screens, decoy) with no routes past LOS. Jaguars actions (Meyers extension, no BTJ trade) confirm limited offensive role intent this season.
items.why: Extremely specialized package matching offseason signals; long season but clear intention.
items.implication: Temper offensive fantasy expectations; more defensive contributor short-term.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3, but same knee had PCL sprain and bone bruise last season—scary history.
items.why: Coach positive on return timeline despite prior knee issues.
items.implication: Monitor closely; potential TE1 if returns early, else stash.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, and tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share) in Chiefs debut, finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 receiving. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominated opportunities, routes, and targets in debut; confirms three-down workhorse intent.
items.implication: RB1 upside locked in with Mahomes; prioritize in ROS rankings and trades.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target/carry share including potential red-zone/two-minute.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty upgrades to high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 carries + 6 targets for 156 yards + 2 TDs in Week 1. Every-down player.
items.why: Elite utilization score tying Bijan; scheme/OL improvements showing.
items.implication: Hold as core RB1; trade value spikes.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game. xFP based on actual targets, location, and depth.
items.why: Strong opportunity volume not reflected in actual production; variance play.
items.implication: Hold or buy low; volume supports rebound.
items.opportunity: High xFP from targets in key areas.

items.text: Travis Etienne downgrades to low-end RB2: 58% snaps but only 43% attempts and 38% routes in three-way committee (Kamara out); boosted by high play volume.
items.why: Committee usage despite Kamara absence; route share low.
items.implication: Temper expectations; Kendre Miller handcuff rises if Kamara slow.
items.opportunity: Split carries/routes; Kamara return further dilutes.
